decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed first floor side extension, would, by reason of its size, scale, and appearance infill an important visual gap, create a terracing effect and would appear as an obtrusive feature, resulting in harm to the appearance of the building and the character and appearance of the Cranford Village Conservation Area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2 and H.6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed two-storey rear extension, would, by reason of its bulk, position and appearance form an obtrusive feature, detrimental to the residential amenity of the neighbouring properties, resulting in loss of outlook and of light, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension and first floor side extension to house
